requirements.text: Patients should be able to book, cancel, or reschedule appointments on their own, with support available if needed.
The portal should enable patients to request repeat prescriptions while minimizing misunderstandings.
There should be a feature to flag urgent cases for same-day appointments.
The portal should send reminders to patients, with careful consideration of how those are communicated.
Notifications for test results should only be sent after a clinician has reviewed and approved them.
Ensure that the portal maintains a personal connection and supports patients throughout the process.
